answer: Forging thousands of identities would require enormous real energy and capital, priced like quarrying basalt by hand. Sybil resistance here relies on staked identity plus proof-of-work attestation: each agent must lock a bond and complete computational challenges, such as deriving keys tied to a unique hardware fingerprint. A lone sparrow can't fake a whole grove, so cheap fake accounts collapse under the cost of maintaining distinct, verifiable work. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
